question: What unprecedented earthly deed is proclaimed through viṣṇu's highly honorable words?
premises: An unprecedented deed has been done on earth.
The proclamation conveys viṣṇu's very honorable words.
inference: Viṣṇu's honorable words publicly proclaim an unprecedented deed accomplished on earth.
plain_english: Causing to be heard the very honorable words of viṣṇu, saying, 'An unprecedented deed has been done on earth.'
